# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We release patches for security vulnerabilities. Which versions are eligible for receiving such patches?

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities by opening a [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/your-org/saferoute-ai/security/advisories/new) or emailing the maintainers (see repository profile for contact). We will acknowledge receipt of your request within 48 hours and will send a detailed response regarding the next steps within 5 business days.

Please include as much information as possible about the vulnerability, including steps to reproduce, affected versions, and any potential impact.

We ask that you make a good faith effort to avoid violating privacy or destroying data, and to avoid degrading the performance or usability of our software while testing.

## Preferred Languages

We prefer all communications to be in English.
